title: Init Chain
statement: Implement `solve(name, team)`. A base class stores a stripped non-empty name. A subclass stores `team` and calls the base initializer. Return `name:team` using the stripped name. A blank name returns `error` and does not include the team.
constraints: The subclass must keep the base name
hints: Validate and store the name on the base.
The subclass calls super().__init__(name) and then stores team.
Return the two fields joined by a colon.
editorial: A subclass that forgets super().__init__ leaves the base attributes unset. The returned string needs both the base name and the subclass team, so a missing base call cannot be hidden. Validation stays on the base so every subclass shares it.
